HET PATEL
AI & Data Science Student | Aspiring Data Scientist
Ahmedabad, Gujarat   |   Ph: 8733001848 |   Email: hetpatel2118@gmail.com
GitHub: github.com/Dyna-Techo
CAREER OBJECTIVE
Final-year AI & Data Science student with practical experience building Python-based projects, including a risk-ranking tool for stocks
and mutual funds and a text classification system for email intent. Published a research paper on AI-driven personalization in
engineering education. Take an end-to-end approach to projects, from exploring raw data and building models to implementing
practical solutions, with a focus on iterative problem-solving. Seeking a Data Science internship to apply this approach to real-world

datasets and contribute to meaningful, data-driven solutions.
EDUCATION
B. Tech in Artificial Intelligence & Data Science  | Apollo Institute of Engineering, Ahmedabad — Expected Graduation: 2027
TECHNICAL SKILLS
• Programming: Python, SQL
• Data Science & Analytics: Pandas, NumPy, Data Cleaning, EDA, Feature Engineering
• Machine Learning: Scikit-learn, K-Means Clustering, Feature Scaling
• Data Visualization: Matplotlib, Seaborn, Power BI
• Tools: Git/GitHub, Jupyter Notebook, Excel
PROJECTS
Customer Churn Prediction — Telecom Analytics with Explainability  | Python, Scikit-learn, XGBoost, SHAP, Streamlit
Live demo = https://vercel.com

CTS
Customer Churn Prediction — Telecom Analytics with Explainability  | Python, Scikit-learn, XGBoost, SHAP, Streamlit
Live demo = https://vercel.com/dyna-techo/churniq-dashboard/Fo1Atyp7Wb8GuXEcywKV9cAaPob2
• Tried Logistic Regression, Random Forest, and XGBoost on the Telco Churn dataset (7,043 customers) and went with Random
Forest since it gave the best results (ROC-AUC 0.842, Recall 0.794).
• Used SHAP to figure out what actually drives churn (Contract Type, Tech Support, Tenure came out on top), then built a Streamlit
dashboard so the results are easy to explore.
Investment Advisor — Risk-Based Stock & Mutual Fund Recommender  | Python, Pandas, Scikit-learn (K-Means)
Live demo = https://vercel.com/dyna-techo/investment-advisor/FtpyRF

sk-Based Stock & Mutual Fund Recommender  | Python, Pandas, Scikit-learn (K-Means)
Live demo = https://vercel.com/dyna-techo/investment-advisor/FtpyRFx7YEvBoJyXcKtWwNyDuSh8
• Built a pipeline covering 441 stocks and 2,032 mutual funds — calculated CAGR, volatility, and Sharpe Ratio for each, then grouped
them into risk tiers using K-Means clustering.
• Added a matching engine that suggests assets based on the user's risk tolerance, time horizon, and investment mode, wrapped in a
simple web interface.
Email Intent Classification System  | Python, Scikit-learn, TF-IDF, Logistic Regression
• Trained a Logistic Regression model on TF-IDF features from 328 labelled emails across 8 intent categories — got 63.5% test
accuracy.
• Built a desktop ap

• Built a desktop app (custom Kinter) so predictions can be checked in real time, with a fallback for low-confidence cases.

Morning (3h): Reasoning Strategies

• Master: Forward vs Backward Reasoning table (6/6 papers) - Write 5 times
• Practice: Procedural vs Decisive table (4/6 papers) - Write 3 times
• Timed: Solve Winter 2024 Q3(c) (Forward vs Backward) in 15 minutes

Afternoon (2h): FOL Conversion

• Target: John likes food problem (Winter 2023) - Master completely
• Practice: Convert 5 new English statements to FOL on your own
• Memorize: Quantifiers: v (for all), ∃ (exists), predicates always start with uppercase

Document ID: SOP-PUMP-001

Purpose:
This procedure defines the basic inspection requirements for centrifugal pumps.

Inspection Requirements:

1. Check pump vibration during normal operating conditions.

2. Check for unusual noise or abnormal operating sounds.

3. Inspect the pump and connected piping for visible leakage.

4. Check bearing temperature and record the observed value.

5. Verify that lubrication is adequate.

6. Record all inspection findings in the maintenance report.

7. Any abnormal condition should be reported to the responsible maintenance engineer.
